fields.name: ShardSetsBase<TConfiguration>.ShardSetWrite fan-out write surface
fields.contract: ShardSetsBase<TConfiguration>.ShardSetWrite accepts a query contract or batch plus parameters and a cancellation token, and executes on the write connection of every shard by default or only the ShardsValues selection. The query families may inject each shard identifier into a named parameter. RunAsync executes query contracts or batches without returning rows; QueryAsync transforms each shard result through a caller-supplied handler and returns the non-null transformed models; MapReaderAsync and MapOutputAsync construct models from mapping attributes using respectively one to eight reader result sets or output-parameter results; ListAsync combines selected-column values or virtual compound keys from the participating shards. All returned collections are List<T>.
